results.title: South Korea’s presidential term limits must not be changed for incumbents
results.description: South Korea’s constitutional ban on extending an incumbent president’s term protects democracy from prolonged rule. Calls to let President Lee Jae Myung benefit from reelection reform threaten the spirit of the 1987 Constitution.

results.title: Brian Mundubile accuses state of moving to block election petition as deadline nears
results.description: Opposition leader Brian Mundubile has accused the Zambian government of working to derail his planned Constitutional Court challenge to President Hakainde Hichilema’s re-election, with the seven-day window to file the petition closing on Monday, 24 August.
